temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria notices Cheryl looking stressed and overwhelmed by the stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project. After Maria offers help, Cheryl gratefully accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria had no specific prior belief about Cheryl’s current workload or need for assistance with this project.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Maria learns Cheryl is overwhelmed and receptive to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is under pressure but open to support, and Maria can assist her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, empathy, and willingness to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Help Cheryl with the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria sees Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing in confidence. During a staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl lead the next phase; Cheryl thanks Maria and accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believed Cheryl was capable and had benefited from help, but had not yet necessarily seen her as ready for a leadership role.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Cheryl’s improved handling, growing confidence, and acceptance strengthen Maria’s belief that Cheryl is ready to lead.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is capable, confident, and willing to take on leadership.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Support Cheryl in taking on the leadership role and help the project succeed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria approaches Cheryl privately to check in. Cheryl says she was a bit surprised but appreciates Maria’s support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believed Cheryl was ready for leadership but worried that her suggestion might have felt like overstepping or pressure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Cheryl’s response shows she feels supported rather than pressured and values Maria’s confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes there are no hard feelings or misunderstandings, and Cheryl appreciates her support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worry and anxiety, then relief and reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ensure Cheryl feels supported and not pressured, and maintain trust between them.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria proposes co-leading the project. Cheryl calls it a fantastic idea, says Maria’s guidance has been invaluable, and agrees they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria felt relieved that Cheryl valued her honesty and support, and believed their collaboration could continue positively.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Cheryl’s enthusiastic agreement confirms that co-leading and mutual support are welcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes co-leading is a good fit and that she and Cheryl can work as a mutually supportive team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Co-lead the project with Cheryl and support each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, strengthening their partnership. Maria proposes teaming up for more future projects, and Cheryl enthusiastically agrees.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believed their partnership was strong and their collaboration had been fruitful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed: Their repeated success and Cheryl’s enthusiasm reinforce Maria’s belief in their synergy and future potential.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes their partnership is strong and that future collaboration is very promising.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Cheryl for more projects in the future.
